## [This website is a website exercise for an assignment from the CS201 class.]{.underline}

To learn more about this assignment, visit <a href="https://abcamp.github.io/assignment.html" id="unique-hover-linkabc" target = "blank">ABCamp's Github</a>.

### [Required Components]{.underline}

1.  The website must be live and functional (the site loads at the URL, navigation works, and nothing is broken)

2.  There must be an **index** page ("**YOU**" are [here](https://pcheng-cham.github.io/))

3.  There must be **three** pages minimum (including index). What the other two pages (<a href="https://pcheng-cham.github.io/about.html" id="unique-hover-linkabc" target = "blank">my 'About' page</a> and <a href="https://pcheng-cham.github.io/resume.html" id="unique-hover-linkabc" target = "blank">my 'Resume' page</a>) include is up to you. All pages must be properly linked in the site navigation **AND** include [*SOME*]{.underline} relevant content (i.e., no empty pages)

4.  There must be at least one media item somewhere (picture, video, embedded pdf, etc.)

5.  There must be at least one customization somewhere (theme/template, colors, TOC, etc.)

6.  Everything should be neat, free of typos, and reflect thought and planning (e.g., no leftover template or placeholder text, page titles match the navigation, etc.)
